2120011120110222201000201210 - ASI: 21

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  02 = 0 * 2
  11 = 1 * 1
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  120 = 1 * 20
  201 = 20 * 1
  210 = 21 * 0
  212 = 21 * 2
  0011 = 00 * 11
  0201 = 0 * 201
  1102 = 11 * 02
  20100 = 201 * 00
  0201210 = 0201 * 210
  1201102 = 120 * 1102
  2120011 = 212 * 0011
  2220100 = 22 * 20100
  21200111201102 = 2120011 * 1201102
  22201000201210 = 2220100 * 0201210
  2120011120110222201000201210 = 21200111201102 * 22201000201210
